openFindings.title: The engine's commit check allows every unowned vendored change when git runs it from a hook in a linked worktree, and no test runs pre-commit under that environment
openFindings.description: Under a hook-exported GIT_DIR, overlay-engine pre-commit returns allow for a staged unowned vendored change in a tree below the git top level, and no test covers that environment for pre-commit

openFindings.title: The restore-failed relayout line and references/overlays.md say the kept backup holds every moved copy, but the backup skips token-named files
No test covers the branch where the relayout rollback itself fails or the backup cannot be removed
A relayout that fails outside its guarded block exits 2 with a raw engine error the apply workflow has no rule for
Generic LAYOUT guidance sends root/skilled lines to relayout in the presentation's next-step rows and the status workflow
A Skilled engine test still names its overlay folder barter-overlays
overlays/README.md does not document that the commit hook refuses a vendored commit when no manifest is found
Phase 008 summary says its folder is uncommitted, in the commit that commits it
Phase 007 summary says the ai-speckit fix reaches origin with phase 008, which pushed nothing in ai-speckit
An in-tree overlayDir that links outside the repository skips the outside-repository refusal
The docs attribute the outside-repository refusal to a pre-commit check that never prints it

nodes.question: Follow-up on the relayout rollback: does apply --relayout now restore every moved copy and leave no half-moved overlay folder when a rename or writeRelayoutManifest fails mid-run (prior R1-P1-001)? Is the rollback itself correct when a restore rename fails, is the writeBackup split sound, and does the new mid-loop failure test fail without the fix?

Do the doctor docs now match the engine: both LAYOUT remedies in doctor-overlay-presentation.txt (prior R8-P2-001), the relayout failure contract in references/overlays.md, and the apply workflow's guidance on reading a failed relayout in doctor-overlay-apply.yaml? Does any doc claim behavior the code does not have?

Barter hygiene: is overlays/relayout-runs/ ignored and documented (prior R3-P2-001), is the barter-overlays fixture renamed (R3-P2-002), does any live barter-overlays or dot-dropped layout reference remain in either repo outside spec history and changelogs, and do the barter-overlay-first rule and overlays/README.md match the hooks? Read-only nested repo.

Are the remediation records traceable: do phases 006-review-remediation, 007-barter-review-fixes and 008-push-and-repin (spec, tasks, acceptance criteria, implementation summaries) and the ai-speckit record (e63bd038a5d) match the code and the test runs they cite, are prior R4-P2-001 (005 acceptance-criteria.md:66) and R6-P2-001 (002 spec.md:109) corrected, and is any completion claim, including the push and the blocked merge of main with origin, made without evidence?
